title.zh: Thinking Machines Lab 推出开放权重 MoE 模型 Inkling，拥有9750亿总参数和41亿活跃参数
title.en: Thinking Machines Lab debuts Inkling, an open-weight MoE model with 975B total and 41B active parameters, trained to be broad rather than optimized for one area

summary.zh: 该模型旨在广泛适用，而非针对单一领域进行优化。

title.zh: AI 倡导者担忧纽约暂停新数据中心的政策可能促使更多州实施限制
title.en: AI advocates fear New York's moratorium on new data centers could embolden Democrats to enact more state restrictions and seize on the issue in the midterms

summary.zh: 民主党可能在中期选举中利用这一议题推动更多州级限制。

title.zh: 中国出台规定禁止陪伴型聊天机器人鼓励情感依赖
title.en: China enacts rules forbidding companionship chatbots from encouraging emotional reliance, banning virtual relationships with minors, and more

summary.zh: 新规还禁止与未成年人建立虚拟关系等行为。

title.zh: OpenAI 详细介绍 GPT-Red：内部自动化红队模型
title.en: OpenAI details GPT-Red, an internal automated red-teaming model that scales prompt injection vulnerability discovery so it can fix bugs before wider deployment

summary.zh: 该模型可扩展提示注入漏洞的发现，以便在更广泛部署前修复问题。

title.zh: Anthropic、Blackstone 和 Hellman & Friedman 推出 AI 实施公司“Ode with Anthropic”
title.en: Anthropic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman's $1.5B AI implementation company, announced in May, launches with the name “Ode with Anthropic” and 100 engineers

summary.zh: 该公司于5月宣布成立，现已正式启动，拥有100名工程师。

title.zh: Cadence 推出 AuraStack AI 超级代理平台
title.en: Cadence unveils AuraStack AI Super Agent, an AI platform for PCB and advanced chip packaging design, with Nvidia, TSMC, and Schneider Electric among early users

summary.zh: 该平台用于 PCB 和先进芯片封装设计，早期用户包括 Nvidia、台积电和施耐德电气。

title.zh: 消息称 DeepSeek 年化收入已达4亿至5亿美元
title.en: Sources: DeepSeek's annualized revenue recently reached $400M to $500M as it seeks to raise ~$7.4B at a ~$74B valuation, up from ~$50B after raising ~$7B in May

summary.zh: 公司正寻求以约740亿美元估值融资约74亿美元，此前5月估值约为500亿美元。

title.zh: 诺基亚计划到2027年向移动运营商销售其 AI 驱动的 RAN 平台
title.en: Nokia plans to sell its AI-driven RAN platform, developed with Nvidia, to mobile operators by 2027, aiming for a 100% increase in spectrum efficiency by 2028

summary.zh: 该平台由诺基亚与 Nvidia 联合开发，目标是到2028年将频谱效率提高100%。

title.zh: Anthropic 推动州级 AI 安全法案，与 OpenAI 的“反向联邦主义”策略形成对比
title.en: How Anthropic is pursuing a state-by-state push for ever-tougher AI safety laws, in contrast with OpenAI's “reverse federalism” strategy for common state rules

title.zh: 消息称苹果计划收购芯片公司以提升其 AI 服务器能力
title.en: Sources: Apple is looking to acquire chip companies to boost its AI server efforts, as it struggles with AI server chip upgrades and M2 Ultra server performance

summary.zh: 苹果在 AI 服务器芯片升级和 M2 Ultra 服务器性能方面面临挑战。

title.zh: 阿联酋因协助美国对伊朗战争获得扩展的美国AI芯片访问权限
title.en: The UAE gained expanded US AI chip access after aiding the US in the Iran war, letting G42 buy freely for at least nine months; G42 plans to become a US company

summary.zh: G42公司在未来至少九个月内可自由购买芯片，并计划成为一家美国公司。

title.zh: 微软安全主管优先发展AI工具并进行高层重组
title.en: Sources: Microsoft security chief Hayete Gallot, who took over in February, has prioritized AI tools, cut several hundred roles, replaced senior execs, and more

summary.zh: Hayete Gallot自2月上任以来，裁减数百个岗位并替换了多名高管。

title.zh: TikTok Shop卖家利用AI创作者和AI双胞胎提升销售
title.en: How TikTok Shop sellers are using AI creators and AI twins to boost affiliate sales; eMarketer: US sales on TikTok Shop will grow 48% YoY to $23.41B in 2026

summary.zh: 预计到2026年，TikTok Shop在美国的销售额将同比增长48%，达到234.1亿美元。

title.zh: Neko Health完成7亿美元融资，估值约70亿美元
title.en: Daniel Ek's Neko Health, which offers AI-based full-body scans, raised $700M co-led by Lightspeed and O.G. Venture Partners, sources say at a ~$7B valuation

summary.zh: Daniel Ek创立的Neko Health提供基于AI的全身扫描服务。

title.zh: OpenAI研究员离职创立AI药物研发初创公司
title.en: Sources: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang is leaving to launch a startup developing AI models for drug discovery, and is in talks to raise ~$200M at a $2B valuation

summary.zh: Miles Wang计划筹集约2亿美元，估值达20亿美元。

title.zh: 印度AI编程初创公司Emergent完成1.3亿美元C轮融资
title.en: Indian AI coding startup Emergent raised a $130M Series C at a $1.5B post-money valuation, up from $300M in January, bringing its total funding raised to $230M

summary.zh: 公司估值从1月的3亿美元增长至15亿美元，总融资额达2.3亿美元。

title.zh: Spectro Cloud完成1亿美元D轮融资，估值超10亿美元
title.en: Spectro Cloud, an AI infrastucture company helping manage token costs, raised a $100M Series D from AMD, LG, others at a $1B+ valuation, up from $750M in 2024

summary.zh: 该公司专注于帮助管理AI代币成本，投资方包括AMD和LG。

title.zh: 以色列Hemispheric公司融资5200万美元开发脑活动分析AI模型
title.en: Israel-based Hemispheric, whose AI model can analyze brain activity measured non-invasively and turn it into quantitative metrics for diagnoses, raised $52M

summary.zh: 该模型可通过非侵入性方式分析脑活动并生成定量诊断指标。

title.zh: 甲骨文领跑向日本提供“隔离云”服务的竞争
title.en: Sources: Oracle leads the race to sell “air-gapped” cloud services to Japan that the US says are key to secure intelligence sharing between Tokyo and its allies

summary.zh: 美国认为此类服务对东京及其盟友的情报共享安全至关重要。

title.zh: PsiQuantum致力于构建基于光子芯片的量子计算机
title.en: A profile of PsiQuantum, which has raised $1B in 2025, is building a quantum computer with GlobalFoundries-made photonic chips, and is highly regarded by DARPA

summary.zh: 该公司已筹集10亿美元资金，并受到DARPA的高度评价。
